page: OVHcloud b2-15 is a general-purpose virtual server hosted on a KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Haswell processor running at 2.0 GHz. The CPU configuration consists of 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. It is equipped with 15.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.75 GB of memory per core. Storage is bundled with a 100 GB local SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results indicate that the b2-15 sits primarily in the lower performance tiers for compute-heavy tasks. Single-core stress-ng performance is in the bottom 10%, while multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench scores, and Passmark CPU scores fall into the bottom 25%. However, memory performance is more balanced; the Passmark memory score and small-block read-only memory bandwidth of 347.69 GB/sec rank in the middle 50%. Database operations and Redis SET operations, which achieve 5.93 million operations per second, also perform at an average level.

The server exhibits clear performance tradeoffs, with weak large-block memory bandwidth and poor medium-model LLM inference speeds. It is not suited for intensive compute, heavy cryptography, or large-scale machine learning. Given its dedicated CPU allocation, 15.0 GB of RAM, and average database and text processing capabilities, the b2-15 is best suited for moderate general-purpose workloads, such as lightweight database hosting, basic web serving, and text processing tasks.
